`htmx.min.js` is [htmx](https://htmx.org) **2.0.11**, copied unchanged so the app works
offline (no CDN). It ships inside the `climpact-web` wheel as a static file.

- Source: <https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/htmx.org@2.0.11/dist/htmx.min.js>
  (the same bytes as `https://unpkg.com/htmx.org@2.0.11/dist/htmx.min.js`)
- SHA-256: `d6fdc75f204e6bdefa99b69bf1e6d4ac69b8a364f77929f45c13476b4000f717`
- Size: 52,182 bytes (16.9 KB gzipped)
- Licence: 0BSD (BSD Zero Clause)

`tests/test_static.py` checks the file against the SHA-256 above. To upgrade, download the
new version's `dist/htmx.min.js`, then update the version, URL, hash and size here.
